scanNote:
Coursebook MUNDARIJASINING o'ng beti. Bosilgan bet raqami: 3.

Uch ustun: LISTENING & SPEAKING, COMMUNICATION, WRITING — 2-betdagi 15 ta unit uchun davomi.

Har qator 2-betdagi unit bilan bir xil rangda bo'yalgan, shuning uchun ikki betni yonma-yon qo'yib o'qish mumkin.

⚠ Bu betda unit RAQAMLARI yoki NOMLARI YO'Q — faqat rang va qator tartibi bo'yicha 2-bet bilan bog'lanadi. Ya'ni bu betni yolg'iz o'qib bo'lmaydi.

⚠ 'Pronunciation' qatorlarida IPA (xalqaro fonetik alifbo) belgilari berilgan: /t/, /h/, /a:/, /ae/, /s/, /z/, /iz/, /th/, /e/, /3:/, /n/, /ng/, /sh/, /ch/, /j/, /A/, /o/, /d/, /id/, /r/ va h.k.

⚠ FOYDALI KUZATUV: 13, 14 va 15-unit qatorlari betning pastida ALOHIDA guruh bo'lib turadi — 2-betdagi MODULE 4 ga mos keladi. Ular orasida bo'sh joy bor, chunki 2-betda o'sha yerda hikoya va baholash qatorlari bor.

⚠ Har unitda 'Project' bor — ya'ni yozma vazifa loyiha shaklida beriladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Contents: Listening & Speaking, Communication and Writing for Units 1-15.
exercises.instructionUz: Mundarija: 1-15 unitlar uchun tinglash-gapirish, muloqot va yozish.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — MUNDARIJANING O'NG BETI.

  ⚠ Bu betda unit RAQAMLARI yoki NOMLARI
  YO'Q — faqat RANG va QATOR TARTIBI
  bo'yicha 2-bet bilan bog'lanadi.

  ⚠ Ya'ni bu betni YOLG'IZ o'qib
  bo'lmaydi — ikki betni yonma-yon qo'yish
  kerak.


TO'LIQ MUNDARIJA (3-bet):

  UNIT 1  Hi!
     L&S: asking for personal information;
          talking about landmarks;
          Pronunciation - names of
          countries and capitals
     C:   introducing people
     W:   Project - famous landmarks;
          introducing ourselves and other
          people

  UNIT 2  A Friend in Need...
     L&S: radio programme about missing
          people; describing people;
          spelling; Pronunciation -
          /t/, /h/
     C:   greetings; saying goodbye
     W:   Project - descriptions of
          people; an Internet
          advertisement for a pen-friend

  UNIT 3  Home Sweet Home
     L&S: describing a house/flat;
          talking to an estate agent;
          Pronunciation - /a:/, /ae/
     C:   asking for and giving addresses
          and phone numbers
     W:   Project - letter to a friend
          describing your house and room;
          advertisements for a house/flat
          to rent

  UNIT 4  Like Father, like Son
     L&S: days you like/hate; talking
          about a person;
          Pronunciation - /s/, /z/, /iz/
     C:   identifying people
     W:   Project - family tree;
          a letter to a pen-friend

  UNIT 5  An Early Bird or a Night Owl?
     L&S: daily routine; interviewing a
          celebrity;
          Pronunciation - /th/ (ikki xil)
     C:   telling the time
     W:   Project - opening hours in your
          country; article about a
          celebrity's daily routine

  UNIT 6  Birds of a Feather
     L&S: identifying animals through
          sounds; describing animals;
          quiz about animals;
          Pronunciation - /e/, /3:/
     C:   asking about pets
     W:   Project - descriptions of
          animals; facts about animals

  UNIT 7  Come Rain or Shine
     L&S: identifying actions through
          sounds; fashion show -
          describing clothes, making
          comments on clothes;
          Pronunciation - /n/, /ng/
     C:   buying clothes
     W:   Project - different seasons in
          your country; a postcard to a
          friend

  UNIT 8  Enjoy your Meal
     L&S: offering; ordering food at a
          restaurant/fast food
          restaurant;
          Pronunciation - /s/, /z/, /iz/
     C:   ordering food;
          accepting/refusing offers
     W:   Project - article about eating
          habits in Britain;
          advertisement for a restaurant

  UNIT 9  Times Change...
     L&S: talking about changes in a
          place; talking about past
          abilities;
          Pronunciation - /s/, /sh/
     C:   giving directions; asking for
          information
     W:   Project - what you were like at
          the age of seven;
          a 'then-and-now' article

  UNIT 10  The Price of Fame
     L&S: painters and paintings/
          composers and music;
          Vivaldi's life;
          Pronunciation - /t/, /d/, /id/
     C:   asking personal questions about
          the recent past
     W:   Project - biography of Mozart;
          biography of Vivaldi

  UNIT 11  All's Well that Ends Well
     L&S: sequence of events; telling a
          story;
          Pronunciation - /A/, /o/
     C:   reporting emergencies
     W:   Project - beginning/ending for
          a story; a story about a fire

  UNIT 12  See New Places, Meet New Faces
     L&S: geography quiz; deciding on a
          hotel;
          Pronunciation - /ch/, /j/
     C:   making comments;
          making suggestions
     W:   Project - description of your
          town; article describing
          Antwerp

  UNIT 13  Time will Tell
     L&S: tomorrow's weather forecast;
          asking for personal
          information;
          Pronunciation - /h/ pronounced
          or silent
     C:   accepting/refusing invitations
     W:   Project - next week's
          horoscopes; letter to a friend
          about your future plans

  UNIT 14  Dos and Don'ts
     L&S: advice about healthy living;
          house rules, school rules;
          Pronunciation - /r/ pronounced
          or silent
     C:   giving advice;
          giving/refusing permission;
          expressing obligation/
          prohibition
     W:   Project - letter giving advice;
          leaflet giving advice to people
          at the beach

  UNIT 15  Take a Break
     L&S: telephone conversation; meeting
          a friend abroad; identifying
          correct responses;
          Pronunciation - /sh/, /ch/
     C:   making a reservation;
          inviting sb out; buying
          souvenirs
     W:   Project - letter to a friend;
          letter to a friend from a
          holiday destination reporting
          your experiences


⚠⚠ HAR UNITDA 'PROJECT' BOR:

  Yozish ustunidagi har bandda 'Project'
  so'zi bor.

  ⚠ Ya'ni yozma vazifa oddiy mashq emas,
  LOYIhA shaklida beriladi: o'quvchi
  o'zining mamlakati, shahri, oilasi
  haqida yozadi.

  Masalan:
     'opening hours in YOUR country'
     'different seasons in YOUR country'
     'description of YOUR town'
     'family tree'

  ⚠ Bu — Culture Clips bo'limidagi
  'Speaking' savollari bilan bir xil
  g'oya: o'z madaniyatingiz haqida
  gapirish.


⚠ 'PRONUNCIATION' QATORLARI:

  Har unitda ikkita (ba'zan uchta) tovush
  o'rgatiladi. Ular IPA (xalqaro fonetik
  alifbo) belgilarida berilgan.

  ⚠ Ikki unitda esa TOVUSh emas, QOIDA
  berilgan:

     13-unit: '/h/ pronounced or silent'
        = 'h' qachon o'qiladi, qachon jim
     14-unit: '/r/ pronounced or silent'
        = 'r' qachon o'qiladi, qachon jim

  ⚠ 110-betdagi talaffuz mashqi aynan
  shu haqda edi.


⚠ 'AN ESTATE AGENT' (3-unit):

  BrE 'an estate agent' = ko'chmas mulk
  agenti (uy sotuvchi/ijaraga beruvchi).

  ⚠ AmE: 'a real estate agent' yoki
  'a realtor'.

  ⚠ 136-betdagi ijara e'lonlari shu unitga
  tegishli.


⚠ 'SB' QISQARTMASI (15-unit):

  'inviting SB out'

  ⚠ 'sb' = 'somebody' (kimdir)
  ⚠ 'sth' = 'something' (nimadir)

  ⚠ Lug'atlarda va darsliklarda joy
  tejash uchun ishlatiladi.


⚠ 'A THEN-AND-NOW ARTICLE' (9-unit):

  = 'o'sha paytda va hozir' maqolasi

  ⚠ Uch so'z DEFIS bilan bog'langan va
  bitta SIFATga aylangan.

  ⚠ 159-betdagi 'step-by-step guidance'
  bilan bir xil qolip.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a landmark    = diqqatga sazovor joy
  an estate agent = ko'chmas mulk agenti
  a celebrity   = mashhur odam
  a composer    = bastakor
  a sequence    = ketma-ketlik
  a forecast    = bashorat (ob-havo)
  a suggestion  = taklif
  a response    = javob
  a reservation = oldindan buyurtma
  a destination = manzil
  an experience = tajriba; boshdan kechirgan
                  narsa
  to refuse     = rad etmoq
  to offer      = taklif qilmoq
  a project     = loyiha
  a biography   = tarjimai hol

exercises.instructionEn: Match each unit to its Communication function.
exercises.instructionUz: Har bir unitni o'z muloqot vazifasi bilan moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
'COMMUNICATION' USTUNI — 15 TA VAZIFA.

  ⚠ Bu mashq kitobda yo'q — mundarijani
  o'zlashtirish uchun qo'shildi.


⚠ 'COMMUNICATION' BO'LIMI NIMA:

  Har unitda bitta AMALIY VAZIFA
  o'rgatiladi: do'konda gapirish, ovqat
  buyurtma qilish, yo'l so'rash va h.k.

  ⚠ Ya'ni bu — 'HAYOTDA KERAK BO'LADIGAN'
  qism.


⚠ ENG AMALIY UChTASI:

     3-unit  — manzil va telefon raqami
     8-unit  — restoranda ovqat buyurtma
     9-unit  — yo'l so'rash va ko'rsatish

  ⚠ Chet elga borganda birinchi navbatda
  shular kerak bo'ladi.


⚠ 'TO ACCEPT' va 'TO REFUSE':

     'to accept' = qabul qilmoq
     'to refuse' = rad etmoq

  ⚠ Ikkalasi 8, 13 va 14-unitlarda bor:
     accepting/refusing offers (8)
     accepting/refusing invitations (13)
     giving/refusing permission (14)

pairs.whyUz:
Mavzu: tanishtirish.

⚠ 'This is my friend Ali.' — tanishtirish
qolipi.
⚠ 'Nice to meet you.' — javob.

Yozish: 'Project - famous landmarks'.

⚠ 'greetings' = salomlashuv so'zlari:
Hello, Hi, Good morning.

⚠ Xayrlashuv: Goodbye, Bye, See you.

Tinglash: yo'qolgan odamlar haqidagi radio
dasturi.

pairs.right: asking for and giving addresses and phone numbers
pairs.rightUz: manzil va telefon raqamini so'rash va aytish
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ ENG AMALIY vazifalardan biri.

⚠ 144-betdagi Britaniya xat manzili qolipi
shu bilan bog'liq.

⚠ Telefon raqamida nol 'oh' deb o'qiladi
(BrE) — 166-betga qarang.

⚠ 'to identify' = tanib olmoq, aniqlamoq.

Mavzu: oila a'zolari.

Yozish: 'Project - family tree'
('a family tree' = shajara).

pairs.left: UNIT 5  An Early Bird or a Night Owl?
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'to tell the time' = soatni aytmoq.

⚠ 135-betda 'half past six' iborasini
ko'rganmiz.

Tinglash: mashhur odamdan intervyu olish.

⚠ 'a pet' = uy hayvoni.

⚠ 138-betda ko'rganimizdek, uy hayvonini
egasi 'he/she' deb ataydi ('it' emas).

Tinglash: hayvonlarni OVOZI bo'yicha tanib
olish.

⚠ Do'konda kerak bo'ladigan vazifa.

⚠ 165-betdagi kiyim so'zlariga ehtiyot
bo'ling: BrE 'pants' = ichki kiyim,
shim esa 'trousers'!

Tinglash: moda namoyishi.

pairs.rightUz: ovqat buyurtma qilish; taklifni qabul qilish/rad etish
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ ENG AMALIY vazifalardan biri.

⚠ 'to order' = buyurtma qilmoq.
⚠ 'to accept' = qabul qilmoq;
'to refuse' = rad etmoq.

⚠ 164-betda ko'rganimizdek, hisob BrE da
'the bill', AmE da 'the check'.

⚠ ENG AMALIY vazifalardan biri — chet elda
kerak bo'ladi.

⚠ 'directions' = yo'l ko'rsatmalari
(ko'plikda).

⚠ 'Turn left', 'Go straight on',
'It's opposite the bank.'

pairs.right: asking personal questions about the recent past
pairs.rightUz: yaqin o'tmish haqida shaxsiy savollar berish
pairs.whyUz:
Grammatika: Past Simple, savol berish.

⚠ 'the recent past' = yaqin o'tmish.

Tinglash: rassomlar va bastakorlar,
Vivaldining hayoti.
⚠ 'a composer' = bastakor.

pairs.left: UNIT 11  All's Well that Ends Well
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'an emergency' = favqulodda vaziyat.
⚠ 'to report' = xabar bermoq.

Mavzu: xavf, his-tuyg'ular.
Yozish: yong'in haqida hikoya.

⚠ Britaniyada favqulodda raqam — 999,
Yevropada — 112.

pairs.left: UNIT 12  See New Places, Meet New Faces
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'a suggestion' = taklif;
'to suggest' = taklif qilmoq.

⚠ Taklif qoliplari: 'Why don't we...?',
'Let's...', 'How about...?'

⚠ 154-betda 'Why not...?' qolipini
ko'rganmiz.

⚠ 'an invitation' = taklifnoma
(143-betda ham bor edi).

⚠ Qabul qilish: 'I'd love to!'
⚠ Rad etish: 'I'm afraid I can't.'

Tinglash: ertangi ob-havo bashorati.
⚠ 'a forecast' = bashorat.

pairs.right: giving advice; giving/refusing permission; expressing obligation/prohibition
pairs.rightUz: maslahat berish; ruxsat berish/rad etish; majburiyat va taqiqni ifodalash

pairs.right: making a reservation; inviting sb out; buying souvenirs
pairs.rightUz: joy band qilish; kimnidir taklif qilish; sovg'a sotib olish
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Sayohat uchun kerakli uchta vazifa.

⚠ 'to make a reservation' (AmE) =
'to book' (BrE) — 165-betga qarang.

⚠ 140-betda 'book a table' iborasini
ko'rganmiz.

⚠ 'sb' = somebody.

groups.explanationUz: Lug'at va darsliklarda joy tejash uchun.

patterns.formula: In Unit [raqam] you learn how to [vazifa].
patterns.exampleEn: In Unit 8 you learn how to order food in a restaurant.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'learn HOW TO' + fe'l — ko'nikma
o'rganish qolipi.

patterns.exampleEn: The Project for Unit 12 is a description of your town.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Har unitda 'Project' bor — o'z
mamlakating haqida yozish vazifasi.

⚠ 'to practise' — BrE da FE'L 's' bilan
(166-betga qarang).
